facts.note: At the temple's nine, Aurèle had the watches shown; the doctor's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Wording differs ('asked us all to show our watches' for 'inspected'), but the content matches.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by the doctor's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and had stopped when he came back.
At the temple's ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and he remarked on it to Madame.
